patterns.note: The homepage features a unique, header-less layout, presenting content in full-bleed, vertically-stacked sections with generous spacing, creating an immersive, editorial experience.
Consistent use of a wide, clean sans-serif typeface (GT-America) across all text, with uppercase for labels and some headings, and very generous letter spacing for an airy, sophisticated feel.
A stark, high-contrast color scheme primarily using black, white, and light grey, which emphasizes content and photography without visual distraction.
Content elements within large sections, such as hero text and subsequent content blocks, reveal with a subtle fade-in and slight upward translation as they scroll into the viewport.

Major content blocks are presented as full-width, full-height sections, often alternating between light and dark backgrounds, acting as distinct visual chapters for different product categories or brand stories.

technique_notes: Sections and their internal content elements are revealed with a subtle fade-in and slight upward translation as they scroll into the viewport, creating a dynamic content flow. The hero section utilizes a video background with text overlays that animate into view.
The site employs a full-bleed, section-based layout where each major content block occupies the full width of the screen, often with significant vertical padding to create an airy, spacious feel.
The homepage specifically omits a persistent top navigation bar, creating an immersive, content-first experience. A standard navigation bar is present on interior pages.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, airy headings (~3-4x body) with small, widely-spaced uppercase labels, all using a consistent sans-serif font.
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy, with large vertical gaps between sections and generous padding within content blocks, creating a minimalist and luxurious feel.

standout: The homepage's extreme minimalism is distinctive, characterized by the complete absence of a visible header or navigation, large expanses of whitespace, and a focus on large, centered typography and full-bleed content blocks. This creates an immersive, editorial experience that prioritizes visual impact over immediate navigation.
